checks.note: Manager decision on #295 H6. Validity checks block a run from the fit and from J: a status not in ok_statuses (setting_refused, frame_map, ocr_error, error, not_activated), a validity_pass column at 0 (measurement rules M1 to M4 and M8), a missing repeat. Every other pass_* column is a known-result equation: a miss is reported per row and in the results, never blocking.

validity_rules.note: Rules of one D run owned by spec/step2d.mjs D_ROW_RULES (M1 input, M2 CPU of both phases, M3 RAM base and OS peak of both phases, M4 retained bytes, M5 beta > 0, M6 frames mapped by time); a broken rule blocks like a validity pass_* row.
